svg.text: Each player is his own population

Own DraftKings fantasy points, his own humps, his own thresholds. Red marks a threshold between clusters; blue marks the high cluster. The 24 of 33 players whose own distribution splits under his rule (median/mode + kurtosis 3), most games first.
30 of the 33 have clusters that each pass the normality test and are therefore usable categories; the rest are marked WRONG FACTOR.
